name: pubmed_search_articles
description: Search PubMed for articles matching a query.

query.description: Search query (e.g., "COVID-19 vaccines", "machine learning AND healthcare")

name: pubmed_download_article
description: Download article details by PubMed ID.

name: pubmed_download_articles_batch
description: Download multiple articles in a single request.

name: pubmed_get_article_summaries
description: Get document summaries for articles (metadata without full content).

name: arxiv_search_papers
description: Search arXiv by query, category, date range, and sort order.

query.description: Search query keywords or boolean expression (e.g., "KAN" OR "Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks").

categories.description: List of arXiv categories to filter by (e.g., ["cs.LG", "cs.AI"]).

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

name: arxiv_get_abstract
description: Fetch metadata and an abstract by arXiv ID without downloading the paper.

name: arxiv_download_paper
description: Download and convert an arXiv paper to local Markdown (with HTML/PDF fallback) for offline reading.

start.description: Character start offset for reading bounded chunks.

max_chars.description: Maximum number of characters to return.

name: arxiv_list_papers
description: List all arXiv papers currently downloaded and stored locally.

name: arxiv_read_paper
description: Read the locally stored full text of an arXiv paper in Markdown format.

max_chars.description: Maximum number of characters to read from the document.

name: arxiv_get_paper_latex
description: Retrieve and locally cache the author-submitted original LaTeX source archive for a paper.

name: arxiv_list_paper_latex_sections
description: Return a paginated outline of sections from the paper's original LaTeX source.

max_sections.description: Maximum number of section items to return.

name: arxiv_get_paper_latex_section
description: Read the bounded LaTeX source content for a single specific section of a paper.

section_id.description: Section identifier from the LaTeX outline (e.g., "3.2") or exact section title.

max_chars.description: Maximum number of characters to return for the section.

name: arxiv_citation_graph
description: Fetch references and citing papers for an arXiv paper via the Semantic Scholar API.

name: arxiv_export_citations
description: Export authoritative BibTeX citation metadata for one or more arXiv paper IDs.

paper_ids.description: List of arXiv paper IDs to export citations for.

name: arxiv_watch_topic
description: Save or update a research topic watch to track newly published arXiv papers.

topic.description: Research topic query string (e.g., "multi-agent reinforcement learning").

categories.description: List of arXiv categories to monitor (e.g., ["cs.AI", "cs.LG"]).

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to fetch during alert checks.

name: arxiv_check_alerts
description: Check saved topic watches for any newly published papers since the last check.

topic.description: Optional specific topic watch to check. If omitted, checks all saved watches.

name: arxiv_semantic_search
description: Search across locally downloaded papers by semantic similarity (requires pro dependencies).

query.description: Text search query for finding semantically similar papers.

paper_id.description: Known arXiv ID to find similar papers to.

max_results.description: Maximum number of similar papers to return.

name: arxiv_reindex
description: Rebuild the local semantic index for downloaded papers (requires pro dependencies).

name: wikipedia_search_wikipedia
description: Search Wikipedia for articles matching a query.

query.description: The search query or term.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10).

name: wikipedia_get_article
description: Get the full content of a Wikipedia article including text, summary, sections, links, and categories.

title.description: The title of the Wikipedia article.

name: wikipedia_get_summary
description: Get a concise summary of a Wikipedia article.

title.description: The title of the Wikipedia article.

name: wikipedia_get_sections
description: Get the sections and structure of a Wikipedia article.

title.description: The title of the Wikipedia article.

name: wikipedia_get_links
description: Get the links contained within a Wikipedia article to other Wikipedia topics.

title.description: The title of the Wikipedia article.

name: wikipedia_get_related_topics
description: Get topics related to a Wikipedia article based on links and categories.

title.description: The title of the Wikipedia article.

limit.description: Maximum number of related topics to return (default: 10).

name: wikipedia_summarize_article_for_query
description: Get a summary of a Wikipedia article tailored to a specific query.

title.description: The title of the Wikipedia article.

query.description: The query to focus the summary on.

name: wikipedia_summarize_article_section
description: Get a summary of a specific section within a Wikipedia article.

title.description: The title of the Wikipedia article.

section_title.description: The title of the section to summarize.

name: wikipedia_extract_key_facts
description: Extract bulleted key facts from a Wikipedia article or a specific topic within it.

title.description: The title of the Wikipedia article.

topic_within_article.description: A specific topic within the article to focus fact extraction on.

count.description: Number of key facts to extract (default: 5).

name: wikipedia_test_wikipedia_connectivity
description: Test connectivity to Wikipedia API and return network diagnostic metadata.

name: hf_whoami
description: Hugging Face tools are being used anonymously and may be rate limited. Call this tool for instructions on joining and authenticating.

name: hf_hub_repo_search
description: Search Hugging Face repositories with a shared query interface. You can target models, datasets, spaces, or aggregate across multiple repo types in one call. Use space_search for semantic-first discovery of Spaces. Include links to repositories in your response.

query.description: Search query keywords.

author.description: Organization or user who created the repository.

sort.description: Sort order (e.g., trendingScore, downloads, likes, createdAt).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10).

name: hf_hub_repo_details
description: Get details for one or more Hugging Face repos (model, dataset, or space). Auto-detects type unless specified. For datasets, use operations: overview, dataset_structure, dataset_preview.

repo_ids.description: Repo IDs for models/dataset/space in author/name format (e.g., ["openai/gpt-oss-120b"]).

operation.description: For datasets, specify operation (overview, dataset_structure, dataset_preview).

config.description: Dataset configuration name when using dataset_preview.

split.description: Dataset split name when using dataset_preview.

name: hf_space_search
description: Find Hugging Face Spaces using semantic search. IMPORTANT: Only MCP Servers can be used with the dynamic_space tool. Include links to the Space when presenting the results.

query.description: Semantic Search Query.

mcp.description: Only return MCP Server enabled Spaces.

name: hf_model_search
description: Find Machine Learning models hosted on Hugging Face. Returns comprehensive information about matching models including downloads, likes, tags, and direct links. Include links to the models in your response.

query.description: Search term. Leave blank and specify "sort" and "limit" to get e.g. "Top 20 trending models".

author.description: Organization or user who created the model (e.g., "google", "meta-llama", "microsoft").

sort.description: Sort order: trendingScore, downloads, likes, createdAt, lastModified.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

name: hf_dataset_search
description: Find Datasets hosted on the Hugging Face hub. Returns comprehensive information about matching datasets including downloads, likes, tags, and direct links. Include links to the datasets in your response.

query.description: Search term. Leave blank and specify "sort" and "limit" to get e.g. "Top 20 trending datasets".

author.description: Organization or user who created the dataset (e.g., "google", "facebook", "allenai").

sort.description: Sort order: trendingScore, downloads, likes, createdAt, lastModified.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

name: hf_paper_search
description: Find Machine Learning research papers on the Hugging Face hub. Include 'Link to paper' when presenting the results. Consider whether tabulating results matches user intent.

query.description: Semantic Search query.

concise_only.description: Return a 2 sentence summary of the abstract. Use for broad search terms.

name: hf_doc_search
description: Search and Discover Hugging Face Product and Library documentation. Send an empty query to discover structure and navigation instructions. Combine with the Product filter to focus results.

query.description: Start with an empty query for structure, endpoint discovery and navigation tips. Use semantic queries for targeted searches.

product.description: Filter by Product. Supply when known for focused results.

name: hf_doc_fetch
description: Fetch a document from the Hugging Face or Gradio documentation library. For large documents, use offset to get subsequent chunks.

offset.description: Token offset for large documents (use the offset from truncation message).

name: hf_dynamic_space
description: Perform Tasks with Hugging Face Spaces. Use "discover" to view available Tasks. Examples are Image Generation/Editing, Background Removal, Text to Speech, OCR and many more. Call with no arguments for full usage instructions.

space_name.description: Space ID (format: "username/space-name"). Required for "view_parameters" and "invoke" operations.

parameters.description: JSON object string of parameters. Only used for "invoke" operation.

name: hf_fs
description: Use to access the Hugging Face Hub filesystem. Navigate resources with ls, cat, find, stat, and search over hf:// URIs. Roots: hf://models, hf://datasets, hf://spaces, hf://buckets, hf://collections, hf://papers, hf://docs.

uri.description: Target Hugging Face URI starting with "hf://" (e.g., "hf://papers/2404.19756").

options.description: Additional command line flags or arguments (e.g., ["--limit", "10"]).

name: hf_hub_query
description: Read-only Hugging Face Hub navigator for discovery, lookup, filtering, ranking, counts, field-constrained extraction, and relationship questions across users, orgs, models, datasets, spaces, collections, discussions, and daily papers.

filters.description: Filter expression or conditions for the query.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

name: kaggle_datasets_list
description: Search and list Kaggle datasets.

page.description: Page number of results to return.

name: kaggle_dataset_files
description: List files in a specific dataset.

owner.description: The Kaggle username or organization that owns the dataset.

dataset_slug.description: The URL slug of the dataset.

name: kaggle_dataset_download
description: Download dataset files (returns a download URL for all files or a specific file).

owner.description: The Kaggle username or organization that owns the dataset.

dataset_slug.description: The URL slug of the dataset.

file_name.description: Optional specific file name to download. If empty, all files are targeted.

name: kaggle_dataset_metadata
description: Get dataset metadata.

owner.description: The Kaggle username or organization that owns the dataset.

dataset_slug.description: The URL slug of the dataset.

name: kaggle_dataset_create
description: Create a new dataset on Kaggle.

owner.description: The Kaggle username or organization that will own the dataset.

slug.description: The desired URL slug for the dataset.

title.description: The title of the new dataset.

file_tokens.description: List of file tokens generated by the file_upload tool.

is_private.description: Whether the dataset should be kept private.

name: kaggle_file_upload
description: Upload a file to Kaggle to receive a file token for dataset creation.

file_name.description: The name of the file being uploaded.

name: kaggle_dataset_get
description: Get full detailed information about a dataset.

owner.description: The Kaggle username or organization that owns the dataset.

dataset_slug.description: The URL slug of the dataset.

name: kaggle_dataset_create_version
description: Create a new version for an existing dataset.

owner.description: The Kaggle username or organization that owns the dataset.

dataset_slug.description: The URL slug of the dataset.

version_notes.description: Notes describing the changes in this version.

file_tokens.description: List of file tokens generated by the file_upload tool.

name: kaggle_dataset_update_metadata
description: Update the title or description metadata for an existing dataset.

owner.description: The Kaggle username or organization that owns the dataset.

dataset_slug.description: The URL slug of the dataset.

title.description: The updated title for the dataset.

description.description: The updated description for the dataset.

name: kaggle_dataset_delete
description: Delete a Kaggle dataset.

owner.description: The Kaggle username or organization that owns the dataset.

dataset_slug.description: The URL slug of the dataset.

name: kaggle_dataset_download_file
description: Download a single file from a dataset (returns a download URL).

owner.description: The Kaggle username or organization that owns the dataset.

dataset_slug.description: The URL slug of the dataset.

file_name.description: The specific file name to download.

name: crossref_search_works_by_query
description: Search for scholarly works using keywords, titles, or authors in the Crossref database.

query.description: Search query for keywords, titles, or authors (e.g., "machine learning in healthcare").

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5).

name: crossref_get_work_metadata
description: Get detailed metadata for a specific scholarly work using its DOI.

doi.description: The Digital Object Identifier (DOI) of the work (e.g., "10.1038/nature14539").

name: crossref_search_journals
description: Search for journals in the Crossref database by name or topic.

query.description: Search query for journal title or subject (e.g., "artificial intelligence").

limit.description: Maximum number of journal results to return (default: 5).

name: crossref_search_funders
description: Search for funding organizations and their supported research in the Crossref database.

query.description: Search query for funder name or keywords (e.g., "National Science Foundation").

limit.description: Maximum number of funder results to return (default: 5).

name: openalex_search_entities
description: Search, filter, sort, or retrieve by ID across all 8 entity types (works, authors, sources, institutions, topics, keywords, publishers, funders). Primary discovery and lookup tool.

id.description: Retrieve a single entity by its identifier (OpenAlex ID, DOI, ORCID, ROR, PMID, PMCID, ISSN). If provided, search/filters are ignored.

search.description: Keyword search across the entity type with support for boolean operators, quoted phrases, and wildcards.

filters.description: Key-value pairs for filtering results based on specific fields (e.g., {"publication_year": "2023-2024"}).

sort.description: Field to sort by, optionally prefixed with '-' for descending order (e.g., "-cited_by_count").

select.description: Specific fields to return in the response to reduce payload size. Use ["*"] for full records.

per_page.description: Number of results to return per page (max 100).

cursor.description: Cursor for paginating through large result sets.

name: openalex_analyze_trends
description: Aggregate entities into groups and count them for trend, distribution, and comparative analysis.

group_by.description: The field to group entities by (e.g., "publication_year", "institutions.country_code", "open_access.is_oa").

filters.description: Filters to scope down the population before aggregation.

include_unknown.description: Whether to include a group representing entities that have no value for the grouped field.

per_page.description: Number of groups to return per page (max 200).

name: openalex_resolve_name
description: Resolve a name or partial name to an OpenAlex ID. Returns matches with disambiguation hints. Also accepts identifiers like DOIs directly.

query.description: The name, partial name, or identifier to resolve.

entity_type.description: Narrow down autocomplete results to a specific entity type. Omit for cross-entity search.

filters.description: Filters to further narrow the disambiguation results (e.g., restricting to a specific country).

name: openalex_get_citation_graph
description: Walk the citation graph one hop from a seed work. Wraps cites, cited_by, or related_to queries.

work_id.description: The OpenAlex ID or DOI of the seed work.

direction.description: The direction of graph traversal. Must be one of "cites", "cited_by", or "related_to".

filters.description: Additional filters to apply to the retrieved neighboring works.

select.description: Specific fields to return for the neighboring works.

per_page.description: Number of results to return per page.

name: openalex_describe_fields
description: List valid filter, group_by, and select field names for a specific entity type. Call before building a query to avoid invalid-field errors.

name: unpaywall_get_paper_by_doi
description: Retrieve Open Access status and full-text links for a scholarly paper using its DOI via the Unpaywall API.

doi.description: The Digital Object Identifier (DOI) of the paper (e.g., "10.1038/nature12345").

name: semantic_scholar_search_papers
description: Search for academic papers by keyword in Semantic Scholar.

query.description: Search query keywords.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

name: semantic_scholar_get_paper_details
description: Get detailed metadata for a specific paper, including abstract, authors, and citation counts.

paper_id.description: Semantic Scholar Paper ID, DOI, ArXiv ID, or MAG ID.

name: semantic_scholar_get_paper_citations
description: Retrieve citing papers for a given paper to walk forward in the citation graph.

paper_id.description: Semantic Scholar Paper ID or DOI.

limit.description: Maximum number of citations to return.

name: semantic_scholar_get_paper_references
description: Retrieve papers referenced by a given paper to walk backward in the citation graph.

paper_id.description: Semantic Scholar Paper ID or DOI.

limit.description: Maximum number of references to return.

name: semantic_scholar_get_author
description: Retrieve metadata and aggregate statistics for a specific author.

name: google_web_search
description: Search the web for current information using Google Custom Search.

query.description: The search query.

count.description: Number of results to return (1-10, default 5).

site.description: Limit the search to a specific domain (e.g., 'example.com').

name: google_image_search
description: Find images related to queries using Google Custom Search.

query.description: The image search query.

count.description: Number of results to return (1-10, default 5).

name: github_search_repositories
description: Search for GitHub repositories using a search query.

query.description: Search query (e.g., "language:typescript topic:mcp").

name: github_get_file_contents
description: Retrieve the contents of a file or directory from a GitHub repository.

branch.description: Branch name, commit SHA, or tag.

name: github_create_or_update_file
description: Create a new file or update an existing file in a GitHub repository.

sha.description: The blob SHA of the file being replaced (required if updating an existing file).

name: github_create_issue
description: Create a new issue in a GitHub repository.

assignees.description: List of usernames to assign to the issue.

labels.description: List of label names to add.

name: github_create_pull_request
description: Create a new pull request in a GitHub repository.

head.description: The name of the branch where your changes are implemented.

base.description: The name of the branch you want the changes pulled into.

draft.description: Indicates whether the pull request is a draft.

name: github_list_commits
description: List commits for a GitHub repository.

sha.description: SHA or branch to start listing commits from.

path.description: Only commits containing this file path will be returned.

name: github_search_code
description: Search for code across GitHub.

query.description: The search query (e.g., "auth repo:owner/repo").
